title: Spectris plc - proposed acquisition of Lochard Limited
industries: Environmental noise management systems and service

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Spectris plc, through its wholly owned subsidiary Spectris Australia Pty Ltd, proposes to acquire Lochard Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the national market for the supply of environmental noise monitoring and management products and services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition would be unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the availability of existing alternative suppliers for products and services; - the availability of imported supply of products and services; and - the ability of customers to credibly threaten to shift the supply of the relevant service elements to in-house operations, and/or to sponsor new entry or expansion for the supply of the relevant product elements.
